こんにちは！僕のキャラクターを気に入ってくれてありがとう！あなたの画風が大好きです！どのキャラを描いてほしいかわからないので、A、B、Cの中から好きなキャラを選んでください。

キャラクターA(193cm)
参考URL：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14Jy-Unm5mh-Oei7ESXqATpZXIGkOdtXM?usp=sharing

親友の死に立ち会った過去に悩む貴族。過去から立ち直ろうとするも、悲しみに打ちひしがれ、欠点だらけの男でありながら、完璧さを表現するために新たな人格を作り上げる。ビショップはメランコリックでありながら破壊的なオーラを漂わせている。その沈痛な表情とは裏腹に、周囲に心配をかけないように笑顔を見せようとする。  彼は思いやりがあり、大切な人を大切にしすぎるほど大切にしており、困っている人にはよく手を貸している。  

- 目の中の黄色、目の下の袋、右目の下のほくろにご注目！

🐍 キャラクターB（180cm）
参考URL：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1j5-cGCR--Guy8jzGG3jyGMemwoWgqVza?usp=sharing

超常現象ネタを追いかけて資料を集める超常現象事務所の下で働くヘビ。仕事は好きではないが、過去の失敗から辞めることができない。他人に愛嬌を振りまいて言いなりにさせる。近くにいるときは笑顔を見せるが、ひとりでいるときは無表情。

- 肌の色と右目の下のホクロにご注目！

⏱️ キャラクターC（188cm）
参考URL：https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1blH7sap9rDxittkJL_jDM_fU4IM_Q1JE?usp=sharing

頑固な性格の努力家。思い通りにならない時、怒り以外の感情を表に出すのが苦手で、自分を落ち着かせるために他人と争うことに頼る。しかし、その反面、友人として見ている多くの人には面倒見がよく、困っている人を見ると解決策を教えることも多い。人の安全を守ろうとするあまり、独占欲が強くなることもある。

- 肌の色、顔のほくろ、傷跡にもご注目！

Hi 白樣，I'm gald to see you start skeb commission! Sorry for that I cannot use Korean to write to you, so I use English instead. I really like your style of painting, and wanna commission you to draw an illustration for my ocs! Whether one or two is all ok！Actually I want you to design their clothes in Mafia paro，but either 立ち絵 or 絡み絵 is welcomed！
（I choose nsfw section just to make you draw freely，it's not mandatory）

My character has different worldviews. I have listed the original medieval timeline and modern vampire worldline. You can opt to draw clothes and settings from this or other connected paros! Here are descriptions:

vampire paro：
▷story

original worldline
▷specific story（still updating）
https://drive.google.com/drive/mobile/folders/1WSZhqSom99pW1G7WVK6f-gE-9RL5oHvn/1CS5WQl8BWpIzrL-HHY3NI_HElq_eeBBj?sort=13&direction=a

▷simplified settings and stories
Background: Medieval Europe
A(185cm，攻め):adoptive father, short silver hair and sky blue eyes. 
He was once a gentle lord, paranoid about revenge due to the betrayal from his country. He is cold and proud in personality, with the elegance and detachment of a nobleman. He never thought he could bear the title of a hero, and sacrificed his human goodness for revenge. However, he was moved and redeemed because B always regarded him as his only hero.

B(178cm，受け):the adopted son with light silver twisted braids and rosy red eyes.
His father was a subordinate of A, and he was entrusted to A before his death. Due to the war and homeless, he had his faith collapsed and has an indifferent personality. After meeting the hero of his youth, however, he was redeemed by A's meticulous care and decided to help A complete the revenge plan.
They are two lonely people, coming together for mutual comfort, licking each other's wounds. On the surface, A appears to be the more composed and taciturn one, while B seems to be the gentler of the two. However, in reality, A is the more gentle and rational one, while B is the one who is mad and fiercely loyal, willing to sacrifice everything for A. Their relationship is kind like dom/sub, with A guides B, and B submits to A.
Although A was deeply betrayed and became obsessed with revenge, even willing to use the power of an evil god to destroy the country, B never gave up on him. B repeatedly persisted in pulling A back from the edge of the abyss, helping A to retain his last shred of humanity. Originally, B had no desire to live, but it was A’s care and love for him that made him willing to sacrifice himself to help A complete a grand reform. Despite A’s inclination to destroy the country and B’s tendency to bring about positive change, they both chose the path of kindness, even going so far as to shape themselves into fanatic-like madmen. They deceived the evil god and attracted his gaze with their own suffering and pain, leading him to B's body. Then B suppressed the consciousness of the evil god with strong willpower and utilized the evil god's  power for himself. Using the power of the evil god, they forced everyone to confront their inner selves and the corruption of the nation. They worked together to develop a plan, executed it separately, one in the open and one in the dark, and ultimately succeeded in bringing positive reforms to the country.
In the final scene, the two of them use themselves as bait, in order to delay enough time for the revolutionary army to invade the royal city. Together, they set up a "stage" on the top of the bell tower of Notre-Dame Cathedral, attracting the attention of all their enemies under the guise of a cult. After the apparent failure of the evil god plan, A and B as per the plan to leap from the bell tower and fake their deaths, then return to the royal city to bring closure to the successful revolution.

Their story is about redemption, revenge, ambition, and the theme of sacrificing oneself for the future of their country.It's also about “人間讃歌は「勇気」の讃歌ッ” when facing the god.
You can draw any feelings about this story！The other things are left to you! Hope you feel free to draw your inspiration!
If you feel the amount is not suitable, you can resend it or feel free to reject it!
